text: Chin Siu-ho, a former vampire-film star abandoned by his wife and son, moves into a decaying Hong Kong tower block and hangs himself, until Yau, a retired jiangshi hunter turned cook, cuts him down. The building is thick with grief: twin girl ghosts who [died after a rape in his flat|wrong|sexual violation], and a sweet old widow who pays a black magician to [bring her dead husband back|wants|getting back the lost]. The coin mask on the corpse's face must stay on, and [what rises when it comes off|threat|the dead that rise] kills.
